title: People’s Mañanera November 12
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**WEG Will Invest US$250 Million Through 2030 in a New Plant in Hidalgo  
** The Brazilian company will manufacture electrical equipment for data
centers and artificial intelligence in Mexico, creating 2,000 direct jobs and
4,000 indirect jobs.

**Foreign Investment at Record Highs  
** “All three sectors of the economy grew,” President Claudia Sheinbaum
reported, as she presented National Statistical Institute (INEGI) figures for
the third quarter of 2026, showing annual growth of 3.2%.

**Banco del Bienestar Launches App and Expects to End 2026 Having Directly
Disbursed 1 Trillion Pesos (US$53.74 Billion)  
** This will allow more than 42 million well-being program recipients to make
transfers, payments, and receive funds via QR code without fees. With more
than 3,100 branches, the Banco de Bienestar it is the only banking option in
over 1,000 municipalities.

**Sheinbaum Calls for an End to Electoral Monopolies  
** “These businesses, operating under the protection of various National
Electoral Institute (INE) and Local Electoral Bodies (OPLE) presidencies, must
be reformed,” the President declared. She supported opening up competition so
that more Mexican producers can manufacture election materials and costs can
be reduced.
